label: The Strongest Shield on the Surface: A

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: ... What's this?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: No time remains for words. I beseech thee for thy protection.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Did you trade Nihilister for Modernia?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: What became of Nihilister? And Liliweiss's body?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... Through mine own negligence, I have failed. I pray thy forgiveness.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Bring her inside for now. Cecil.

lines.speaker: cecil_op_l
lines.text: So, this makes the third Heretic you've let inside. This will surely go down in history.

lines.speaker: cecil_op_l
lines.text: Have them taken to the weapons development lab. It's the most heavily fortified area, and it held up relatively well against the beam.

lines.speaker: cecil_op_l
lines.text: You won't need the infirmary, in any case.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Many thanks.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Young Hero, prithee, show us the way.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Find it yourself. I'm busy.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Verily, I am not without sense of direction, yet Eden's interior is labyrinthine, and its structure hath been greatly altered by the beam...

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Nayuta!

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Oh, Persinette.
Rapunzel's gaze falls upon the battered Marian.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Marian...! What happened?!

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Let's move her!

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I shall assist thee.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I bear ill tidings, Young Hero.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Out with it.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: The Maiden of Thunder and the Loquacious One shall verily join the fray.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: ... Are you talking about Indivilia and Chatterbox?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: So it is. And should the worst come to pass,

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Fire Dragon may verily join them as well.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: ... It must be because of that signal that's similar to the calling signal the Queen emitted earlier.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Truly so.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Fine, I'll make the preparations.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I would entreat it of thee.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: ... She's recovering, albeit slowly.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: 'Tis simply for that she hath sustained a grievous wound. So formidable an adversary did she face, verily.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Judging by the wounds, this must be Indivilia's doing.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: So it seems.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: ... What happened?

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Why is Marian here by herself?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... I know not. Perchance she came, having beheld Eden's Spear.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Nayuta.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... I humbly apologize. By mine own lips, I cannot reveal the reason.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Unless Young Lady Marian herself chooses to disclose it, I may not speak of it.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: ... All right.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: For now, all we can do is force power into Marian's core.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: We'll have to trust her self-healing ability to do the rest.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Very well. I shall keep watch over her.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I am presently engaged in my preparations, and thus on this battlefield there is naught I may accomplish save for trifling tasks...

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: ... I'll leave it in your hands. And now, I'll return to Sister Noah.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: May your toil bear fruit.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: See you lat—

lines.speaker: cecil_op_l
lines.text: The Queen's energy signature detected.

lines.speaker: johan_op_r
lines.text: Everyone, prepare for bombardment!

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Oh no...!
Rapunzel runs off.
Nayuta glances between Rapunzel's retreating figure and Marian,
then squeezes her eyes shut.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... By my word, how much longer must we tarry...?

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Y-you mean that thing's coming again!? Seriously?!

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: Ah, so you heard it too, huh?

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Wow, if we can't block this, Eden's totally screwed.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Can you really block it?

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: Quit whining right beside me and go!

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: You're nothing but a nuisance here!

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: ... Go where?
The sky turns red.
The deepening crimson light gradually dyes the clouds an ominous hue.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Noah!

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: Mo-move it, will ya?!

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: I'm sorry!

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: Are you ready?

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: Then let's block this thing!

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: All right, let's go!
Before long, a crimson pillar of light
pierces through the clouds and pours down.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: I-it's huge...!

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Normally, size trumps all, but not this time!

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: Huh? What are you on about?
From Noah's two shields, a wide electromagnetic field spreads out.
Rapunzel lifts her staff, unfolding a golden barrier before her.
An ominous red light strikes both shield and barrier,
its impact scattering fragments of light in all directions.
The deflected beam rain down,
scorching the earth and melting the Raptures that rush in.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: Hrrrnggh...!

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: It's... okay! We... can block it!

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: You bet... we can!
The Queen's beam does not stop.
It continues to aim at Eden in an unbroken stream.
Papillon sits on the ground, watching the two holding back the red light pouring down over them.
Their posture lowers. Their breathing grows ragged. Their faces twist.
This isn't going to work.
A grim thought crosses Papillon's mind:
why isn't anyone coming to help?
She doesn't even know what they could do, but they could at least try.
Papillon crawls to the edge and peers out.
The deflected beam falls around Eden
like a rain of fire.
And beneath that fiery downpour, they fight.
Snow White, covered in something, fires without pause. Harran scatters some strange powder.
Scarlet cuts through Raptures under the flames. Isabel weaves through the fire, harrying the Raptures behind enemy lines.
Meanwhile, Papillon is paralyzed with fear.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: They're... crazy...
*Fwoooom!*
The Queen's beam intensifies.
Rapunzel and Noah are pushed back.
Without thinking, Papillon catches them by the waist.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Keep blocking, you lunatics!

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Hnnnngh!

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: Urrrrgh!
Rapunzel's golden barrier flares even brighter.
In that instant, she realizes that her core's power is depleted.
Just before she collapses forward, she feels someone tug at her collar.
Noah grabs Rapunzel and hurls her behind herself.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Sis... ter No... ah!

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: Hey! You said it!

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: A shield that protects someone can block anything!

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: What a load of nonsense! There's no such thing!

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: I'm the strongest, you hear me? I'm the strongest!

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: I'm not protecting anything! I just need to prove that I'm the strongest!

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: So you lot better cling to me and pray you make it out alive!

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Noah! If you increase your output any further...!

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: Me!

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: I'm the strongest shield on the surface!!
The ominous crimson light halts, and the rain of fire ceases.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: ... Heh, too bad Firepower Four Eyes didn't get to see that.

lines.speaker: cecil_op_l
lines.text: ... Defense complete. Damage to Eden is minimal.

lines.speaker: johan_op_r
lines.text: Well done, Noah.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Wh-whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa!

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: You actually blocked it?!

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: You arrogant brat, you really are incred—
*Thud*
Noah goes rigid and collapses backward.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: ... *Gasp!*
Noah's entire front is scorched black.
Her eyes, nose, and mouth—every feature has been burned away. Only a charred body remains.
Where her core should be, there's nothing but a gaping, hollow cavity.
She doesn't move an inch.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: ... Hey, you arrogant brat, what's wro—
Papillon gently shakes Noah's body.
*Psshh*
Black ashes scatter from Noah's body.
Noah is completely still, like something hardened into stone.
Papillon collapses to the ground, landing on her rear.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Wha...

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Wh-what is this?

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Ugh...!
Rapunzel carries Noah and runs,
but her staggering steps cause her to fall.
On impact, Noah's arm shatters like charred wood.
Trembling, Rapunzel lifts Noah again and keeps running.
Meanwhile, Papillon can only stare blankly, screaming in desperation.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Cecil! Cecilllll!

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Rapunzel and Noah are heading to the infirmary! Hurry!

lines.speaker: cecil_op_l
lines.text: Got it, I'll make the necessary preparations.

lines.speaker: johan_op_r
lines.text: ... Everyone, conduct maintenance and resupply.

lines.speaker: johan_op_r
lines.text: Another Rapture attack is imminent.

lines.speaker: johan_op_r
lines.text: Indivilia and Chatterbox have been confirmed.

lines.speaker: johan_op_r
lines.text: Nihilister as well.
